An '''Inquisitor''' during the first year of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had caught the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] teenage [[Gender/Legends|boy]] [[Kajin Savaros]] in the upper levels of [[Ploughtekal Market]] coaxing a vendor to give him food. Savaros hadn’t even gotten through half of the skewer he was eating when the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] cornered him. Savaros had been able to escape but was left traumatised by the encounter.<ref name="CN3" />
